name: analyze_image_for_deepfake
description: Analyze an image for deepfake manipulation using a 4-model ensemble. Returns a verdict (FAKE/REAL), confidence score, natural language reasoning, and per-model breakdowns. Models: FSFM-3C (face manipulation), Organika (AI-generated images), SigLIP (general AI detection), Face Forensics (mathematical analysis including FFT frequency, landmark consistency, symmetry, texture, and edge artifacts).

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze. The agent should download this and POST it to the API.

api.note: Download the image from image_url, then POST it as multipart/form-data with field name 'file'

reasoning.description: Natural language explanation - relay this directly to the user

models_agreeing_fake.description: Number of models that detected fake (0-4)

detected_by.description: Names of models that flagged the image as fake

usage_examples.agent_action: Download the image, POST to /analyze, then relay the 'reasoning' field to the user along with the verdict and confidence.

usage_examples.scenario: User asks 'What kind of deepfake is this?'
usage_examples.agent_action: Check the 'detected_by' array and 'model_details' to identify which manipulation type was detected. FSFM-3C detects face swaps, Organika detects AI-generated images, Forensics detects mathematical artifacts.
